title: Haaye Alamdaar Haye Alamdaar
body:
utho mere ghamkhaar wafadar baradar chehlum ke liye ayi hoon {2} ghazi main ujadkar
<<MINI>>
haye alam dar haye alamdar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
1. har ghaam pe bhai mein uthati thi musibat
seli kabhi kode kabhi durron ki aziyat aur uspe qayamat. . . . .
bazar mein thi bibiyan be maqna -o- chadar
<<MINI>>
haye alamdar haye alamdar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
2. kistarha kahoo kitni satayi gayi zainab
bazaro mein shehro mein phirayi gayi zainab
bhai gayi zainab. . . . .
rone bhi nahi dete the jee bhar ke sitamgar
<<MINI>>
haye alamdar haye alamdar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
3. aye bhai suno sham -e- ghareeba ki ye rudad
qaime jale chadar chini main ho gayi barbad
sun lo meri fariyad. . . . .
aaye na madad ko meri aye mere baradar
<<MINI>>
haye alamdar haye alamdar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
4. zindan mein har lamha tadapti thi sakina
aghosh chacha ki thi na baba ka tha sina
dushwar tha jeena. . . . .
ghut ghut ke wahi margayi bachi meri akhar
<<MINI>>
haye alamdar haye alamdar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
5. be maqna -o- chadar sar -e-bazar gayi hoon
shiree se kabhi umme habiba se mili hoon
main toot gayi hoon
sar sharm se mera kabhi utha na baradar
<<MINI>>
haye alam dar haye alamdar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
6. abbas asiri ne hume khoob rulaya
ummat ne bahut aal-e-payamber ko sataya aur qaidi banaya . . . . .
baazoo pe nasha rassi ke layi hoon baradar
<<MINI>>
haye alam dar haye alamdar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
7. hakim ke tarafdar har ek simt layee the aur kursiyon pe baithe huwe dushman -e- deen the
hum qaak nashee the . . . . .
aankhon mein abhi tak hain wo darbar ka manzar
<<MINI>>
haye alam dar haye alamdar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
8. manzar yahi kehti rahi roro ke wo dukhiya
turbat pa alamdar ki majlis huwi barpa
zainab ka tha nauha. . . . .
jaun main watan kis liye aur kya karoo jeekar
<<MINI>>
haye alam dar haye alamdar . . . . .
